brief:
Settlers detained residents in the West Bank village of Beita while Israeli forces prevented ambulances from reaching the area, Shehab Wire reported. The incident occurred as potential casualties were unable to receive immediate medical attention due to the blockade on emergency services.

Details of the detention remained limited, though the incident reflected ongoing tensions between Palestinian residents and Israeli settlers in the West Bank. The prevention of ambulance access raised concerns among residents about medical emergencies in the village during the standoff.
